observations.finding: The observed learning nodes are t=0.00 through 0.49 in steps of 0.01, within the declared [0,0.5] window. Coordinate summaries describe predicted endpoints in the world frame (angstrom representation), not current atom states or physical velocities. Regional statistics average children within extant parent and score stratum before equally averaging batches. Terminal score time is 0.99 and terminal state time is 1.0; immediate selection and terminal survival use different outcomes.

Whole-window high-minus-low selection contrasts favor reduced x/y shape spread and a different pair-distance profile: shape_xx=-0.495 z (CI -0.648 to -0.320, q=0.000813, negative in 13/14 batches); shape_yy=-0.513 z (CI -0.620 to -0.424, q=0.0000149, negative in 14/14). Pair kernels at 1.5/2.5/3.5 have positive contrasts +0.562/+0.631/+0.540 z in 14/14 batches; the 7.0 kernel is -0.485 z in 14/14. These related geometry descriptors are overlapping evidence, not independent beneficial mechanisms.

Compressed salient fields do not reproduce joint teacher choice: top-four overlap with fixed-frame Hungarian RMS is 0.470 (batch-bootstrap CI 0.427 to 0.515), with excess fixed RMS 0.081 A (CI 0.070 to 0.092). The compressed chosen-teacher distance remains 0.529 A after proper rigid alignment with fixed correspondence. This establishes information loss relevant to full geometry, but does not identify distinct conformational modes or show which representation improves affinity.

Landmark 00 has mutually consistent selection associations: lower softmin (-0.481 z, q=0.000813), higher occupancy3 (+0.545 z, q=0.000235), and higher parent-debiased regional soft mass (+0.639 z, CI 0.492 to 0.791, q=0.000188); each has the same direction across all 14 batches. Landmark 10 soft mass is also higher (+0.395 z, q=0.000372, 14/14). Signed local y offsets differ by region: landmark 06 is +0.425 z (q=0.000115, 14/14 positive), landmark 12 is -0.529 z (q=0.000411, 14/14 negative), while global centroid_y is -0.243 z (q=0.0136, 11/14 negative). The spatially varying contrasts motivate localization checks, without proving added information beyond common shape and translation.

Empirical node contrasts change direction across the complete window. Landmark 00 soft mass is -0.366 z at t=0, peaks at +1.641 at t=0.16, and is -0.275 at t=0.49 despite its positive whole-window effect. Landmark 00 local_cyy reaches -1.336 at t=0.24 but ends +0.253. Landmark 06 local_dy peaks at +1.270 at t=0.20 and ends -0.334; landmark 12 local_dy reaches -1.386 at t=0.05 and ends +0.166. These are descriptive node contrasts without supplied node confidence intervals; whole-window signs cannot safely become fixed or monotone rules.

All 24 audited fitted endpoint curves are marked unavailable for Legendre runtime use. For example, shape_yy ends at observed +0.163 z versus fitted -0.513 z; landmark 06 softmin ends at observed -0.402 versus fitted +0.294. None satisfies the supplied combined fidelity rule. Stage-dependent hypotheses should use the supplied regional node functions or observed-node interpolation at supported nodes, with no extrapolation beyond the window.

Change and parent-edge evidence must be separated from level enrichment. Landmark 00 softmin has success-minus-failure integrated rate -4.914 (CI -6.855 to -2.616, q=0.0461, negative in 13/14), the sole increment feature with q<0.05; occupancy3 rate is +4.277 but q=0.0811. Regional parent-edge local_cxx at landmark 04 is -4.596 (q=0.00325, negative in 14/14), while landmark 01 enrichment-change local_dz is +1.621 (q=0.00196, positive in 14/14). These standardized rate effects describe endpoint forecast changes, not physical atomic motion, and are not directly comparable in magnitude to level effects.

Future-credit evidence is weaker than immediate selection: no survival field/measure test reaches q<0.05 under the joint 400-test BH correction (minimum q=0.1204). Landmark 00 soft mass survival enrichment is +0.365 z (CI 0.200 to 0.515, 12/14 positive), smaller than immediate selection enrichment; landmark 07 local_cyy survival enrichment is -0.299 z (q=0.219). Although all 14 batches have survival coverage, 349/700 batch-nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531/700 fewer than 6. The teacher pool contains only 17 to 28 teachers per node, with at most 2 per batch; descendants and clones do not increase independent sample size.

The incumbent program_20 has discovery mean predicted pIC50 delta +0.2303, validity change +0.010, MMFF relief per heavy median 0.4769 and p90 0.9546. It has the highest supplied mean delta, but exceeds program_3/program_4 by only about 0.001, without uncertainty estimates. Program_19 has lower mean delta (+0.2128) and lower p90 (0.9079); program_8 has lower mean (+0.1390) and still lower p90 (0.7310). Mean affinity and strain tails therefore require separate comparison; these adaptive reused discovery batches do not establish a winning program.

hypotheses: Retain the registered incumbent program_20 unchanged as the candidate for a fresh paired generation comparison: endpoint_pointcloud with endpoint reference, mixture_temperature=0.5, native_rms_ratio=0.33, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0, teacher_neighbors=4, teacher_score_beta=2.0 and time_ramp_power=0.0. Its competitive discovery mean and strain summaries support testing, not a claim of superiority (quality:program_20; quality:program_3; quality:program_19). Compare final mean predicted affinity over all attempts/failures and physical tails separately, using paired independent batches.

Joint endpoint geometry may preserve useful conformation distinctions lost by marginal moment compression. Prefer testing the already registered pointcloud candidate before assigning independent positive rewards to correlated shape and pair-kernel features; the evidence does not resolve specific alternative modes or prove an affinity benefit (information_audit; endpoint_effects:3; endpoint_effects:4; endpoint_effects:10).

Landmark 00 enrichment and spatially varying local offsets are candidates for node-conditioned selection preference. Any future regional rule should follow observed supported nodes and be tested for added information after conditioning on global shape/translation; defer a residue-level mechanism or universal attraction direction (regional_effects:0; regional_effects:62; regional_effects:122; regional_curves; curve_support).

Defer terminal-survival weighting and terminal-score credit as established affinity features: corrected survival support and ancestral diversity are insufficient. Treat absent future affinity labels as missing, with their missingness reported in a future paired analysis (survival_effects:0; lineage_support).

counterevidence.finding: General compaction and one preferred conformation are not established: shape_zz fails q<0.05, shape_xy and shape_xz have intervals crossing zero, and the joint-choice audit supplies no mode decomposition. The positive geometric distance excess is by construction, not causal affinity evidence.

Late observed sign reversals and failed curve fidelity counter a fixed, monotone, or fitted-polynomial stage rule. A significant integrated association can coexist with an opposite last-node contrast.
Survival contrasts attenuate and lose corrected significance; lineage support is sparse. Immediate selection associations cannot be promoted to final-quality or future-score credit.

The highest discovery mean is essentially tied with alternatives, and lower strain p90 appears in other programs. A best-valid pIC50 or shape-improvement fraction alone does not satisfy the mean-affinity and strain-tail objective; adaptive reuse prevents independent validation.

limitations: Only bound evidence was inspected. No inference, generation, external lookup, source implementation inspection, or source/Skill editing was performed.
Selection associations are observational. Untyped distance kernels and landmark moments do not identify chemical interactions, residue mechanisms, energies, or causally favorable motifs.

There are 14 independent generation batches; within-batch nodes, related descriptors, overlapping Gaussian regions, children and repeated descendants are correlated. Regional effects have no supplied residualized comparison against global motion or a feature-correlation matrix.

Empirical functions contain 50 nodes through t=0.49, with no node-level confidence intervals or full coordinate/mode reconstruction. The execution contract permits exact learned nodes only, native continuation after the window, the endpoint VJP path, zero additional production forward calls, no affinity-head gradient, no SMC, no graph veto, and only compiler-accepted bounded scalar updates.

Lineage summaries report survival rather than terminal affinity-effect contrasts. Future affinity-label missingness and clone multiplicities are not quantified in the supplied evidence; missing values cannot be classified as affinity failures.

Discovery quality provides point summaries without paired batch uncertainty, explicit affinity failure accounting, raw physical tails, a baseline strain comparison, or a definition of material strain regression. Retaining program_20 for comparison does not establish improvement or non-regression.
